featured.title: Cosmino
featured.tagline: Early-stage startup app built from scratch
featured.description: Building the core Flutter application for an early-stage startup, working closely with founders on product features and Firebase backend integration.
points: Contributing to Flutter development for a large-scale entertainment application across Android and iOS, building the complete onboarding journey including multi-step registration, profile setup, Google Sign-In and Firebase Authentication
Built live session infrastructure enabling users to discover, join and manage scheduled events, integrating Vimeo for video content and Whereby for real-time virtual meetings
Implemented end-to-end monetization features including Razorpay payment integration, in-app purchases, and a wallet, coupon and promotional offer system backed by secure API workflows
Integrated Firebase Remote Config to enable fast, controlled feature rollouts without app releases, alongside Cloud Messaging and Analytics to drive user engagement and monitor app health
Designed and implemented pixel-perfect responsive UI from Figma, while optimizing app performance by refactoring modules and reducing unnecessary widget rebuilds
Managed Play Store and App Store release cycles end-to-end and implemented event tracking with Amplitude to measure user behavior and feature engagement

featured.title: B2B Jewellery Marketplace
featured.description: A B2B platform where retailers browse jewellery catalogs and place wholesale orders. Built the Flutter app with order management, catalog, and real-time tracking features.
points: Architected the core authentication and onboarding experience, including OTP auto-fill login and a multi-language onboarding flow for first-time users, significantly reducing signup friction across the app

Redesigned the product catalog UI by refactoring a toggle-based category switch into a scalable TabBar system supporting Bulk, Mass and Single product flows, with Google Maps integration for location-aware browsing

Built and integrated complex catalog features end-to-end, including Bulk Product Listing APIs with deep navigation and data binding, a fully API-driven Coupon Card system, and an advanced weight-based seller-side filtering engine

Independently designed and shipped the app's Home page from scratch in Figma — including an interactive Weight Range selector with dynamic quantity controls, Shop by Seller, and Similar Products sections — fully wired to backend APIs
